faqs.a: The layout is chosen automatically: 2 photos side-by-side, 3 as one large plus two stacked, 4 as a 2×2 grid, and 5–6 as a 3×2 grid.
faqs.q: How is the collage layout chosen?

faqs.a: The collage is exported at 1200 px wide (height depends on the layout) as a lossless PNG.
faqs.q: What size is the exported collage?

faqs.a: Yes — each photo is center-cropped to fill its cell, so nothing is stretched or squashed.
faqs.q: Are my photos stretched to fit?

howto: Drop 2 to 6 photos onto the dropzone (only the first 6 are used).
Adjust the gap between photos and the background color.
Download the collage as a PNG.
